messages:
eli-partnerships: Heads-up 1: BridgeWire reached out about listing BW-3B quantized weights as a packaged SKU in our cloud marketplace. They want rehosting + an HW-accelerated bundle with Partner-X.

maria-ops: Any existing template for a marketplace bundle where the model provider supplies quantized artifacts and we handle listing + billing split?

samir-legal: Key legal checks: redistribution rights for binaries, permission to convert/quantize (if we do), export controls, and clarity on commercial redistribution. BridgeWirelaimed an "Apache-like" header but added a redistribution clause . Need exact language.

eli-partnerships: They sent this clause:

```
Redistribution: Binary redistribution permitted with attribution. Commercial redistribution requires a separate commercial license and executed Redistribution Agreement.
```

samir-legal: That requires negotiation. We need explicit rehosting permission for quantized/converted artifacts, rights to distribute in marketplace images, and clear indemnities/representations re: training data.

laura-product: From product side: propose SKUs:
- "BW-3B (software-only, quantized)"
- "BW-3B + Partner-X Accelerator (bundled, validated)"
We need perf numbers, expected throughput, and memory footprint for the SKU page.

tim-eng: On the engineering side: packaging quantized checkpoints is supported. Two constraints:
- compatibility matrix from Partner-X (drivers/kernels),
- artifact integrity (signed hashes) for air-gapped installs.

maria-ops: I'll prepare the SKU manifest template (model size, quant type, memory, perf, tested latency) and an infra ticket for hash verification.

eli-partnerships: I'll ask BridgeWire for the stripped perf harness and the exact quantization pipeline (scripts, versions).

ops-bot: Reminder: attach license docs to the partnership record: https://github.com/redwood/partnerships/tree/bridgewire

samir-legal: Also need logo usage rules and a one-paragraph license summary for the SKU page. I'll draft a Redistribution Addendum to request: rehosting rights, permission to bundle with hardware, commercial redistribution clause, revenue share terms, and export control reps.

bridgewire-external: We'll provide quant artifacts + perf harness by EOD Thursday. We propose a 70/30 rev share in our favor and will include logo guidelines.

maria-ops: Once artifacts arrive I'll spin a validation instance and share the SKU manifest.

tim-eng: We'll run compatibility tests in parallel with legal review. If BridgeWire won't allow redistributable quant scripts, we need reproducible scripts + seed so we can generate artifacts and sign them.

eli-partnerships: Action items recap:
- Eli: request artifacts, perf harness, and propose timeline
- Maria: SKU manifest template, infra ticket for signing
- Samir: draft addendum and assess export escalation
- Tim: prepare compatibility testbed and signing workflow

laura-product: No public joint announcement until legal/compliance sign-off. If cleared, we'll coordinate PR assets and embargo timing.

bridgewire-external: Understood. We'll upload artifacts and addendum draft to your repo. Looking forward to working together.

eli-partnerships: Thanks everyone. Will update thread when docs arrive. :thumbsup:
